headline.en: A shanty is a work song: the shantyman sings, and the crew answers together. In Drunken Sailor the crew's answer is "Hooray and up she rises".

title.en: As big as you could keep up

detail.en: Like calling a friend across a garden
Never your throat; stop if anything tightens or hurts
The calls sound in your rests either way

Hear the shantyman's line, then answer: "Hooray and up she rises".

measures.en: Scored on your answers on pitch.

text.en: Now the whole song: the shantyman sings the verse, then you sing the chorus, all four lines.

measures.en: Scored on your answers on pitch.

headline.en: Haul Away, Joe was for sweating up: one short answer and one strong pull, to get the last inch out of a rope. The shantyman calls, and the crew answers.

title.en: As big as you could keep up

Hear the call, then answer: "Way, haul away, haul away, Joe". Breathe in the call.

measures.en: Scored on your answers on pitch.

headline.en: Blow the Man Down hoisted a sail: the long hoist. While the shantyman sang, the crew shifted their hands on the rope and took a breath, low and quiet.

No breath halfway through
Never your throat; stop if anything tightens or hurts

Hear the call, then answer. Take your breath in the call's last word.

headline.en: Now the beat: on a real rope, everyone pulled on the same word, or nothing moved. Aim the "aw" of "haul" at the beat, not the h.

The calls sound in your rests either way

measures.en: Scored on your answers on pitch and on the beat.

headline.en: Drunken Sailor was stamp and go: a big crew grabbed the rope and tramped away along the deck with it, so the beat is your feet. It was also sung at the capstan.

detail.en: Walk it if you like
The "oo", not the h; stop if anything tightens or hurts
The calls sound in your rests either way

text.en: The verse from the shantyman, then your chorus on the beat.

measures.en: Scored on your answers on pitch and on the beat.

headline.en: A halyard shanty had two short answers, with a double pull in each. Same answers as before, now on the beat, at a steady hoist.

detail.en: Together, on the beat
Steady before fast; stop if anything tightens or hurts
The calls sound in your rests either way

text.en: The call, then your two answers on the beat.

measures.en: Scored on your answers on pitch and on the beat.

headline.en: Leave Her, Johnny was a capstan shanty: no pull, the crew walked the capstan bars round and round, so the beat is your feet. It was sung coming into port.

detail.en: Every answer in on the beat
Just walking, round and round; stop if anything tightens or hurts
The calls sound in your rests either way

text.en: Find the chorus's notes: "Leave her, Johnny, leave her".
A verse: the shantyman sings, you answer each chorus on the beat.

measures.en: Scored on your answers on pitch and on the beat.

headline.en: Two verses of Leave Her, Johnny, the last song of a voyage: every chorus on the beat, walked round the capstan.
